sentences.zh: 畢，帝旋位立，眾退，復班次，樂止。

translations.literal: When finished the emperor returned to stand; the crowd withdrew and re-formed ranks; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When finished the emperor stood again; the crowd re-formed ranks; music ceased.

sentences.zh: 鳴鞭，中和韶樂作，奏和平章。

translations.literal: The whip sounded; Zhonghe music played the Heping movement.
translations.idiomatic: The whip sounded; Zhonghe played Heping.

sentences.zh: 太上皇帝還宮，樂止。

translations.literal: The retired emperor returned to the palace; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The retired emperor returned; music ceased.

sentences.zh: 帝御殿，群臣進錶行禮如儀。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the hall; ministers presented memorials and performed the rite as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the hall; ministers presented memorials as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后、皇太后、皇后三大節朝賀儀順治八年，定元旦慈寧宮階下設皇太后儀杖、樂器，皇太后御宮，樂作。

translations.literal: Grand empress dowager, empress dowager, and empress three great festivals congratulatory audience rites: In Shunzhi 8 on New Year's Day ceremonial staffs and instruments were set on the steps of the Cining Palace; the empress dowager entered the palace; music played.
translations.idiomatic: Grand empress dowager, empress dowager, and empress three great festivals: In Shunzhi 8 on New Year's Day staffs and instruments were set on Cining steps; the empress dowager entered; music played.

sentences.zh: 升座，樂止。

translations.literal: She ascended the throne; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: She ascended; music ceased.

sentences.zh: 帝率內大臣、侍衛詣宮行三跪九叩禮。

translations.literal: The emperor led inner grand ministers and guards to the palace with three kneelings and nine kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor led inner grand ministers and guards with three kneelings and nine kowtows.

sentences.zh: 畢，公主、福晉以下，都統、子、尚書命婦以上，行六肅三跪三叩禮。

translations.literal: When finished, from princesses and fujin down to commandants' wives of the third rank and above performed six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, princesses and fujin down to commandants' wives of third rank performed six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 作樂如初，大設筵宴。

translations.literal: Music played as at first; a great banquet was set.
translations.idiomatic: Music as before; a great banquet was set.

sentences.zh: 冬至、聖壽節同，唯冬至罷宴。

translations.literal: Winter solstice and sacred longevity were the same, only on winter solstice the banquet was omitted.
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice and sacred longevity were the same; winter solstice omitted the banquet.

sentences.zh: 康熙八年，定元日太皇太后、皇太后儀駕、中和韶樂、丹陛大樂全設。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 8 on New Year's Day the grand empress dowager's and empress dowager's full guard, Zhonghe music, and Dandi grand music were all set.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 8 on New Year's Day full guard, Zhonghe, and Dandi music were all set.

sentences.zh: 帝率王公大臣、侍衛暨都統、子、尚書以上官，先朝太皇太后宮，次詣皇太后宮，行禮如儀。

translations.literal: The emperor led princes, great ministers, guards, and officials of commandant, viscount, and minister rank and above first to the grand empress dowager's palace, then to the empress dowager's, performing the rite as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor led princes, great ministers, guards, and officials of commandant rank and above first to the grand empress dowager, then the empress dowager, as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 畢，皇后率公主、福晉、命婦行禮亦如之。

translations.literal: When finished the empress led princesses, fujin, and wives to perform the rite likewise.
translations.idiomatic: When finished the empress led princesses, fujin, and wives likewise.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，諭京、外進表官集午門外行禮。

translations.literal: In year 21 an edict ordered memorial-presenting officials within and without the capital to assemble outside the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 memorial presenters within and without the capital assembled outside the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 尋置糾儀御史，分列宮門外、午門外儀駕末，嚴監視。

translations.literal: Soon discipline censors were placed outside palace gates and at the end of the guard outside the Meridian Gate for strict supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Soon discipline censors stood outside palace gates and at the guard's end outside the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年，定慶賀皇太后許二品命婦入班，尋諭世爵朝賀增入男爵。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 12 congratulating the empress dowager allowed wives of the second rank into the ranks; soon an edict added ennobled males to hereditary-title congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 12 second-rank wives entered empress-dowager congratulations; soon ennobled males were added.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十五年，諭值皇太后三大節，將軍、督、撫、提、鎮具表慶賀，罷遞黃摺祝文。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 25 an edict on the empress dowager's three great festivals ordered generals, governors, and commanders to submit congratulatory memorials and discontinued yellow folded felicitations.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 25 on the empress dowager's three great festivals generals, governors, and commanders submitted memorials; yellow folded felicitations were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 道光元年元旦，大學士先進皇帝慶賀表文，帝始率群臣詣宮行禮。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day of Daoguang 1 Grand Secretaries first presented the emperor's congratulatory memorial; then the emperor led ministers to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On Daoguang 1 New Year's Day Grand Secretaries first presented the emperor's memorial; then he led ministers to the palace.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，皇太后、皇帝同御慈寧宮受賀，明年，改御養心殿。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 1 the empress dowager and emperor together received congratulations at the Cining Palace; the next year they changed to the Hall of Mental Cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 empress dowager and emperor received congratulations at Cining; next year they moved to the Hall of Mental Cultivation.

sentences.zh: 王、公、二品以上官，集慈寧門外，三品以下集午門外，朝鮮使臣列西班末，按班行禮，不贊。

translations.literal: Princes and officials of the second rank and above assembled outside the Cining Gate; third rank and below outside the Meridian Gate; Korean envoys at the end of the western rank; by rank without vocal prompts.
translations.idiomatic: Second rank and above outside Cining Gate; third rank and below outside Meridian Gate; Korean envoys at western rank end; by rank without prompts.

sentences.zh: 冬至、聖壽節同。

translations.literal: Winter solstice and sacred longevity were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice and sacred longevity were the same.

sentences.zh: 唯遇大慶年，俟皇太后升殿後，增用宣表例。

translations.literal: Only in great celebration years, after the empress dowager ascended the throne, the proclaiming memorial precedent was added.
translations.idiomatic: Only in great celebration years, after the empress dowager ascended, proclaiming the memorial was added.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，皇太后聖壽，皇帝親進表文，餘儀同。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 2 on the empress dowager's sacred birthday the emperor personally presented the memorial; the rest was the same.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 on the empress dowager's sacred birthday the emperor personally presented the memorial; the rest was the same.

sentences.zh: 皇后向無受群臣賀儀，順治間，定元旦慶賀，儀仗全設。

translations.literal: The empress had no rite of receiving ministers' congratulations; in Shunzhi New Year's congratulations were fixed with full ceremonial guard.
translations.idiomatic: The empress had no rite of receiving ministers' congratulations; in Shunzhi New Year's congratulations used full guard.

sentences.zh: 皇后詣皇太后宮行禮畢，還宮，自公主及命婦俱詣皇后宮朝賀。

translations.literal: After the empress performed the rite at the empress dowager's palace she returned; from princesses and wives all went to the empress's palace to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: After rites at the empress dowager's she returned; princesses and wives all congratulated at the empress's palace.

sentences.zh: 冬至、千秋節同。

translations.literal: Winter solstice and longevity festival were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice and longevity festival were the same.

sentences.zh: 康熙時，定皇后先詣太皇太后宮，次皇太后宮行禮，還宮升座，自公主迄鎮國將軍夫人，公、侯迄尚書命婦，咸朝服行禮。

translations.literal: In Kangxi the empress first went to the grand empress dowager's palace, then the empress dowager's, returned and ascended the throne; from princesses down to the wife of the commandant of the state, and from dukes down to ministers' wives, all in court dress performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi the empress first visited grand empress dowager, then empress dowager, returned and ascended; princesses down to commandants' wives and dukes' down to ministers' wives in court dress performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，始令皇后千秋節王公百官咸蟒袍補服，後准此行。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 6 it was first ordered that on the empress's longevity festival princes and officials all wear python robes and rank badges; later this was approved as constant.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 6 on the empress's longevity festival princes and officials wore python robes and rank badges; later made constant.

sentences.zh: 攝六宮事皇貴妃千秋節，儀同皇后。

translations.literal: On the longevity festival of the imperial noble consort administering the six palaces, the rite was the same as the empress's.
translations.idiomatic: For the noble consort administering the six palaces, longevity rites matched the empress's.

sentences.zh: 大宴儀凡國家例宴，禮部主辦，光祿寺供置，精膳司部署之。

translations.literal: Grand banquet rites: For statutory state banquets the Ministry of Rites presided, the Court of Imperial Entertainments supplied settings, and the Directorate of Fine Foods deployed them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand banquet rites: Statutory banquets were led by the Ministry of Rites, supplied by the Court of Imperial Entertainments, deployed by Fine Foods.

sentences.zh: 建元定鼎宴，崇德初，太宗改元建號，設宴篤恭殿。

translations.literal: Founding-era capital-fixing banquet: Early in Chongde when Taizong changed the era and state title, a banquet was set in the Palace of Respect and Reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Capital-fixing banquet: Early in Chongde when Taizong changed era and state, a banquet was set in the Palace of Respect and Reverence.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，定鼎燕京，設筵宴、設寶座皇極門正中，帝升座，賜百官坐，賜茶、進酒，俱一跪一叩。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 when the capital was fixed at Yanjing, banquets were set; a throne was set at the center of the Huangji Gate; the emperor ascended; officials were granted seats; tea and wine were granted—each with one kneeling and one kowtow.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 when Yanjing was fixed, a throne stood at Huangji Gate center; the emperor ascended; seats, tea, and wine were granted—each one kneeling and one kowtow.

sentences.zh: 宴畢謝恩如初禮。

translations.literal: When the banquet was finished gratitude was performed as in the first rite.
translations.idiomatic: When finished gratitude followed the first rite.

sentences.zh: 是日賜宴，有內監數輩先行拜舞，諭：「朝賀大典，內監不得沿明制入班行禮。

translations.literal: That day at the banquet several eunuchs advanced first to bow and dance; an edict said: "At the great congratulation ceremony eunuchs must not follow Ming practice and enter the ranks."
translations.idiomatic: That day several eunuchs bowed and danced first; an edict said: "At the great congratulation eunuchs must not follow Ming practice and enter the ranks."

sentences.zh: 」裁抑宦官自此舉始。

translations.literal: " Restraining eunuchs began with this act.
translations.idiomatic: Restraining eunuchs began with this.

sentences.zh: 元日宴，崇德初，定制，設宴崇政殿，王、貝勒、貝子、公等各進筵食牲酒，外籓王、貝勒亦如之。

translations.literal: New Year's banquet: Early in Chongde the regulation was set; banquets in the Chongzheng Hall; princes, beile, beizi, and dukes each presented feast meat and wine; outer-domain princes and beile likewise.
translations.idiomatic: New Year's banquet: Early Chongde banquets in the Chongzheng Hall; princes, beile, beizi, and dukes presented feast meat and wine; outer princes likewise.

sentences.zh: 順治十年，令親王、世子、郡王暨外籓王、貝勒各進牲酒，不足，光祿寺益之，御筵則尚膳監供備。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 10 princes, imperial sons, commandery princes, and outer princes and beile each presented meat and wine; if insufficient the Court of Imperial Entertainments supplemented; the imperial table was supplied by the Imperial Kitchen Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 10 princes, imperial sons, commandery princes, and outer princes each presented meat and wine; Fine Foods supplemented shortfalls; the imperial table by the Kitchen Directorate.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年罷，越數歲復故。

translations.literal: It was discontinued in Kangxi 13; after several years the old practice returned.
translations.idiomatic: Discontinued in Kangxi 13; after several years restored.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，改燔炙為餚羹，去銀器，王以下進餚羹筵席有差。

translations.literal: In year 23 roasting was changed to stewed dishes; silver vessels were removed; princes and below received graded stewed banquet tables.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 roasting became stew; silver removed; graded stew tables for princes down.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，定元旦宴儀，是日巳刻，內外王、公、台吉等朝服集太和門，文武各官集午門。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 4 New Year's banquet protocol was fixed; that day at the si hour inner and outer princes, dukes, and taiji in court dress assembled at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; civil and military officials at the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 New Year's protocol was fixed; at si hour princes and taiji at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; officials at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 設御筵寶座前，內大臣、內務府大臣、禮部、理籓院長官視設席。

translations.literal: The imperial banquet table before the throne; inner grand ministers, Domestic Affairs ministers, Rites, and Domains chiefs oversaw seating.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial table before the throne; inner grand ministers and Rites and Domains chiefs oversaw seats.

sentences.zh: 丹陛上張黃幔，陳金器其下，鹵簿後張青幔，設諸席。

translations.literal: A yellow canopy on the red steps; gold vessels below; behind the guard a green canopy and other seats.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow canopy on the red steps with gold below; green canopy and other seats behind the guard.

sentences.zh: 鴻臚寺官引百官入，理籓院官引外籓王公入。

translations.literal: Entertainments officers led officials in; Domains officers led outer princes in.
translations.idiomatic: Entertainments led officials in; Domains led outer princes in.

sentences.zh: 帝御太和殿，升座，中和韶樂作，王大臣就殿內，文三品、武二品以上官就丹陛上，餘就青幔下，俱一叩，坐。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the Hall of Supreme Harmony and ascended; Zhonghe music played; great ministers took places inside the hall; civil third rank and military second and above on the red steps; the rest under the green canopy—all one kowtow and sit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered and ascended; Zhonghe played; great ministers inside; civil third and military second on red steps; rest under green canopy—one kowtow and sit.

sentences.zh: 賜茶，丹陛大樂作，王以下就坐次跪，復一叩。

translations.literal: Tea was granted; Dandi music played; princes and below knelt at their seats and again one kowtow.
translations.idiomatic: Tea granted; Dandi played; princes knelt at seats and kowtowed again.

sentences.zh: 帝飲茶畢，侍衛授王大臣茶，光祿官授群臣茶，復就坐次一叩。

translations.literal: When the emperor finished tea, guards handed tea to great ministers and Entertainments officers to the ministers; they returned to seats and again one kowtow.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor finished tea, guards and Entertainments served great ministers and officials; they kowtowed again at seats.

sentences.zh: 飲畢，又一叩，樂止。

translations.literal: When drinking was finished, again one kowtow; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When drinking finished, again one kowtow; music ceased.

sentences.zh: 展席冪，掌儀司官分執壺、爵、金卮，大樂作，群臣起。

translations.literal: Covers were spread; Ceremonial officers held pots, cups, and gold goblets; grand music played; the ministers rose.
translations.idiomatic: Covers spread; ceremonial officers held pots, cups, and goblets; grand music; ministers rose.

sentences.zh: 掌儀司官舉壺實酒於爵，進爵大臣趨跪，則皆跪。

translations.literal: Ceremonial officers filled cups from pots; when the advancing minister hurried to kneel, all knelt.
translations.idiomatic: Officers filled cups; when the advancing minister knelt, all knelt.

sentences.zh: 掌儀司官授大臣爵，大臣升自中陛，至御前跪進酒。

translations.literal: Ceremonial officers handed the cup to the great minister; the great minister ascended the central steps to the throne, knelt, and presented wine.
translations.idiomatic: Officers handed the cup; the great minister ascended central steps, knelt, and presented wine.

sentences.zh: 興，自右陛降，復位，一叩，群臣皆叩。

translations.literal: He rose, descended by the right steps, returned to place, one kowtow; all kowtowed.
translations.idiomatic: He rose, descended right, returned, one kowtow; all kowtowed.

sentences.zh: 大臣興，復自右陛升，跪受爵，復位，跪。

translations.literal: The great minister rose, again ascended by the right steps, knelt to receive the cup, returned, and knelt.
translations.idiomatic: He rose, ascended right again, knelt to receive the cup, returned, and knelt.

sentences.zh: 掌儀司官受虛爵退，舉卮實酒，承旨賜進爵大臣酒。

translations.literal: Ceremonial officers received the empty cup and withdrew; they raised the goblet with wine and, by edict, granted wine to the presenting great minister.
translations.idiomatic: Officers took the empty cup; raised the goblet and by edict granted wine to the presenter.

sentences.zh: 王以下起立，掌儀司官立授卮，大臣跪受爵，一叩，飲畢，俟受爵者退，復一叩，興，就坐位，群臣皆坐。

translations.literal: Princes and below rose; ceremonial officers stood handing goblets; the great minister knelt to receive the cup, one kowtow; when drinking was finished, after the cup-bearer withdrew, again one kowtow, rose, and took his seat; all sat.
translations.idiomatic: Princes rose; officers handed goblets; the great minister knelt, kowtowed, drank, kowtowed again, rose, and sat; all sat.

sentences.zh: 樂止，帝進饌。

translations.literal: Music ceased; the emperor took his meal.
translations.idiomatic: Music ceased; the emperor ate.

sentences.zh: 中和清樂作，分給各筵食品，酒各一卮，如授茶儀。

translations.literal: Zhonghe clear music played; food and one goblet of wine were given each table as when tea was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe clear music; food and one goblet per table as with tea.

sentences.zh: 樂止，蒙古樂歌進。

translations.literal: Music ceased; Mongol music and song entered.
translations.idiomatic: Music ceased; Mongol music entered.

sentences.zh: 畢，滿舞大臣進，滿舞上壽。

translations.literal: When finished, Manchu dance ministers advanced; Manchu dance offered longevity.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu dance ministers advanced; Manchu dance offered longevity.

sentences.zh: 對舞更進，樂歌和之。

translations.literal: Facing dance advanced again; music and song harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: Facing dance advanced; music harmonized.

sentences.zh: 瓦爾喀氏舞起，蒙古樂歌和之，隊舞更進。

translations.literal: Waljarka dance rose; Mongol music harmonized; rank dance advanced again.
translations.idiomatic: Waljarka dance rose; Mongol music harmonized; rank dance advanced again.

sentences.zh: 每退俱一叩。

translations.literal: Each withdrawal was one kowtow.
translations.idiomatic: Each withdrawal one kowtow.

sentences.zh: 雜戲畢陳。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous entertainments were presented when finished.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous entertainments followed.

sentences.zh: 訖，群臣三叩。

translations.literal: When finished the ministers performed three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: When finished ministers performed three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 大樂作，鳴鞭，韶樂作，駕還宮。

translations.literal: Grand music played; the whip sounded; Shao music played; the procession returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Grand music; the whip; Shao music; return to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬至宴，順治間制定如元旦儀，後往往停罷。

translations.literal: Winter solstice banquet: Fixed in Shunzhi like the New Year's protocol; afterward it was often suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice banquet: Fixed in Shunzhi like New Year's; afterward often suspended.

sentences.zh: 元會宴，凡元正朝會，歲有常經，遇萬壽正慶，或十年國慶，特行宴禮。

translations.literal: New Year assembly banquet: For the New Year court assembly there is the annual constant; when the Longevity Festival is a major celebration, or a ten-year national celebration, a special banquet rite is held.
translations.idiomatic: New Year assembly banquet: The New Year court has its annual constant; major Longevity or ten-year national celebrations add a special banquet.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十五年、五十五年，聖制元會作歌，宴儀如前。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 35 and 55 the Sage personally composed New Year assembly songs; banquet protocol was as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 35 and 55 the emperor composed New Year assembly songs; banquet protocol unchanged.

sentences.zh: 惟行酒後，慶隆舞進，司章歌作，司舞飾面具，乘禺馬，進揚烈舞。

translations.literal: Only after wine was served the Qinglong dance entered; the Director of Seals sang; dancers wore masks, rode fish-dragon mounts, and advanced the Yanglie dance.
translations.idiomatic: After wine the Qinglong dance entered; the Director of Seals sang; masked dancers on fish-dragon mounts advanced the Yanglie dance.

sentences.zh: 司弦箏阮節抃者，以次奏技。

translations.literal: Zither, pipa, and clapper players performed skills in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Zither, pipa, and clapper players performed in turn.

sentences.zh: 喜起舞，大臣入，行三叩禮，循歌聲按隊起舞，歌闋，笳吹進，番部合奏進，內府官引朝鮮俳，回部、金川番童陳百戲，為稍異耳。

translations.literal: The Xilai dance: great ministers entered, performed three kowtows, and danced in ranks to the song; when the song ended, horn and pipe entered; frontier ensembles advanced; inner-court officers led Korean players; Turkestani, Jinchuan, and frontier children presented hundred entertainments—slightly different.
translations.idiomatic: Xilai dance: ministers entered, three kowtows, danced by ranks to the song; then horns, frontier ensembles, Korean players, Turkestani and Jinchuan children presented entertainments—slightly different.

sentences.zh: 千秋宴，為康熙五十二年創典，設暢春園。

translations.literal: Longevity banquet for the aged: Created in Kangxi 52; set at the Garden of Exuberant Spring.
translations.idiomatic: Longevity banquet for the aged: Created Kangxi 52 at the Garden of Exuberant Spring.

sentences.zh: 凡直省現官、致仕漢員暨士庶等，年六十五以上至九十者咸與。

translations.literal: All incumbent officials of direct provinces, retired Han officials, and commoners from sixty-five to ninety were included.
translations.idiomatic: Incumbent direct-province officials, retired Han officials, and commoners aged sixty-five to ninety were included.

sentences.zh: 遣子孫、宗室執爵授飲，分給食品，諭毋起立，以示優崇。

translations.literal: Sons, grandsons, and imperial clansmen were sent to hold cups and grant drink; food was distributed; they were told not to rise—to show honor.
translations.idiomatic: Sons, grandsons, and clansmen held cups; food was distributed; they were told not to rise—in honor.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年，設宴乾清宮，自王、公訖內、外文、武大臣暨致仕大臣、官員、紳士、兵卒、耆農、工商與夫外籓王、公、台吉，回部、番部土官、土舍，朝鮮陪臣，齒逾六十者，凡三千餘人。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 50 a banquet was set in the Palace of Heavenly Purity; from princes and dukes through civil and military great ministers, retired great ministers, officials, gentry, soldiers, aged farmers, artisans, and merchants, and outer princes, dukes, taiji, Turkestani and frontier native officials and chiefs, Korean attendants—all over sixty, more than three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 50 a banquet at the Palace of Heavenly Purity included princes through merchants, frontier chiefs, and Korean attendants over sixty—more than three thousand.

sentences.zh: 其大臣七十以上，餘九十以上者，子孫得扶掖入宴。

translations.literal: Great ministers over seventy and others over ninety could be supported by sons and grandsons into the banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers over seventy and others over ninety could be supported by sons and grandsons.

sentences.zh: 年最高者，如百五歲司業銜郭鍾岳等，得隨一品大臣同趨黼座，親與賜觴。

translations.literal: The oldest, such as Guo Zhongyue with the title of director at one hundred five, could approach the throne with first-rank great ministers and receive cups in person.
translations.idiomatic: The oldest, such as Guo Zhongyue at one hundred five, approached the throne with first-rank ministers and received cups in person.

sentences.zh: 宴罷，頒賞珍物有差。

translations.literal: When the banquet was finished treasured gifts were bestowed in grades.
translations.idiomatic: When finished treasured gifts were bestowed by grade.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初元再舉，設宴皇極殿，與宴者三千五十六人，邀賞者五千人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing it was held again; a banquet at the Hall of Imperial Supremacy; three thousand fifty-six attended; five thousand received invitation gifts.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiaqing's beginning it was held again at the Hall of Imperial Supremacy; 3,056 attended; 5,000 received gifts.

sentences.zh: 上自榑槐，下逮袀襏，以至蒙、回、番部、朝鮮、安南、暹羅、廓爾喀陪價，略其年甲，咸集丹墀，誠盛典也。

translations.literal: From the canopy tree down to coarse cloth, including Mongol, Muslim, frontier, Korean, Annamese, Siamese, and Gurkha attendants—age was not considered—all gathered in the courtyard; truly a great ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: From high to low, Mongol, Muslim, frontier, Korean, Annamese, Siamese, and Gurkha attendants without age limit—all in the courtyard; a great ceremony.

sentences.zh: 大婚宴，順治八年，大婚禮成，設宴如元旦儀。

translations.literal: Grand wedding banquet: In Shunzhi 8 when the grand wedding was complete a banquet was set like New Year's.
translations.idiomatic: Grand wedding banquet: In Shunzhi 8 after the grand wedding a banquet like New Year's was set.

sentences.zh: 並進皇太后筵席牲酒，嗣後仿此。

translations.literal: The empress dowager's banquet meat and wine were also presented; afterward this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager's banquet meat and wine were also presented; afterward likewise.

sentences.zh: 耕耤宴，順治十一年舉行，命曰「勞酒」。

translations.literal: Ploughing and silk banquet: Held in Shunzhi 11; called "reward wine."
translations.idiomatic: Ploughing and silk banquet: Shunzhi 11; called "reward wine."

sentences.zh: 凱旋宴，自崇德七年始。

translations.literal: Triumph banquet: From Chongde 7.
translations.idiomatic: Triumph banquet: From Chongde 7.

sentences.zh: 順治十三年定制，凡凱旋陛見獲賜宴。

translations.literal: Fixed in Shunzhi 13: whenever returning from triumph at court audience a banquet was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed Shunzhi 13: after triumph audience a banquet was granted.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，定金川，宴瀛台；

translations.literal: In mid-Qianlong, when Jinchuan was pacified, a banquet at the Ocean Terrace;
translations.idiomatic: In mid-Qianlong, when Jinchuan was pacified, a banquet at the Ocean Terrace;

sentences.zh: 定回部，宴豐澤園；

translations.literal: when Turkestan was pacified, a banquet at the Fengze Garden;
translations.idiomatic: when Turkestan was pacified, at Fengze Garden;

sentences.zh: 及平兩金川，錫宴紫光閣。

translations.literal: and when the two Jinchuan were pacified, a banquet at the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: when both Jinchuan were pacified, at the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 其時所俘番童有習鍋莊及甲斯魯者，番神儺戲，亦命陳宴次，後以為常。

translations.literal: Frontier children captured who knew the Guozhuang and Asilu dances and frontier spirit-mask plays were also ordered at the banquet; afterward this became constant.
translations.idiomatic: Captured frontier children who knew Guozhuang, Asilu, and spirit-mask plays were ordered at the banquet; afterward constant.

sentences.zh: 道光八年，回疆奠定，錫宴正大光明殿，是日大將奉觴上壽，帝親賜酒，命侍衛頒從征大臣酒，餘如常儀。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 8 when Turkestan was settled a banquet was granted at the Hall of Great Light; that day the commander offered longevity; the emperor personally granted wine and ordered guards to distribute wine to expedition great ministers; the rest as usual.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 8 when Turkestan was settled a banquet at the Hall of Great Light; the commander offered longevity; the emperor granted wine and guards served expedition ministers; rest as usual.

sentences.zh: 宗室宴，乾隆十一年，設宴瀛台，賜宗室王公，遵旨長幼列坐，行家人禮，並引至淑清院流杯亭遊覽，賜酒果。

translations.literal: Imperial clan banquet: In Qianlong 11 a banquet at the Ocean Terrace granted imperial princes and dukes; by edict elders and juniors sat by age and performed family rites; they were also led to the Floating Cup Pavilion in the Shuqing Garden for wine and fruit.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clan banquet: Qianlong 11 at the Ocean Terrace; elders and juniors by age with family rites; also the Floating Cup Pavilion with wine and fruit.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，設宴乾清宮，命皇子、王、公等暨三、四品頂戴宗室千三百有八人入宴。

translations.literal: In year 48 a banquet at the Palace of Heavenly Purity; princes, dukes, and third- and fourth-rank imperial clansmen—1,308 entered.
translations.idiomatic: Year 48 at the Palace of Heavenly Purity: princes, dukes, and third- and fourth-rank clansmen—1,308 entered.

sentences.zh: 其因事未與宴者咸與賞，都凡二千人。

translations.literal: Those absent by circumstance all received gifts; in all two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Absentees received gifts; in all two thousand.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶九年，設筵惇敘殿，略同瀛台宴。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 9 a banquet at the Hall of Cordial Kinship; much like the Ocean Terrace banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaqing 9 at the Hall of Cordial Kinship; like the Ocean Terrace banquet.

sentences.zh: 外籓宴，歲除日設保和殿，賜蒙古王、公等，凡就位、進茶、饌爵、行酒、樂舞、謝恩，並如元會儀。

translations.literal: Outer-domain banquet: On New Year's Eve a banquet was set at the Hall of Preserving Harmony for Mongol princes and dukes; taking seats, tea, food, presenting cups, serving wine, music, dance, and gratitude—all as in the New Year assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Outer-domain banquet: New Year's Eve at the Hall of Preserving Harmony for Mongol princes and dukes; seats, tea, food, wine, music, dance, and gratitude as New Year assembly.

sentences.zh: 其來朝進貢，送親入覲，或御賜恩宴，或宴禮部，取旨供備。

translations.literal: For coming to court with tribute, escorting kin to audience, or imperial grace banquets, or banquets at the Ministry of Rites—supply followed edict.
translations.idiomatic: For tribute audiences, escorting kin, imperial grace banquets, or Ministry of Rites banquets—supply followed edict.

sentences.zh: 至諸國朝貢，如朝鮮、安南、琉球、荷蘭遣使來京，亦有例宴。

translations.literal: For tributary states such as Korea, Annam, Ryukyu, and Holland sending envoys to the capital there were also statutory banquets.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Annam, Ryukyu, and Holland envoys also had statutory banquets.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，緬甸使臣陪宴萬樹園，以其國樂器五種合奏。

translations.literal: In Qianlong, Burmese envoys were banqueted at the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees with five kinds of their national instruments in joint performance.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong Burmese envoys banqueted at the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees with five national instruments.

sentences.zh: 厥後凡遇筵宴，備陳准部、回部、安南、緬甸、廓爾喀樂。

translations.literal: Thereafter at banquets music of the Zunbu, Turkestan, Annam, Burma, and Gurkha was fully provided.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Zunbu, Turkestan, Annam, Burma, and Gurkha music was provided.

sentences.zh: 又順治中，定制鄉試宴順天府，會試及進士傳臚宴禮部。

translations.literal: Also in Shunzhi the provincial examination banquet at Shuntian Prefecture and metropolitan examination and palace examination banquets at the Ministry of Rites were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Also in Shunzhi: provincial banquet at Shuntian, metropolitan and palace banquets at the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 餘如臨雍、經筵、修書、初舉日講、臨幸翰林院、繕寫神牌，亦賜宴如例。

translations.literal: Others such as lecturing at the Imperial Academy, classics lecture, book compilation, first classics lecture, imperial visit to the Hanlin Academy, and copying spirit tablets also received banquets by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Lecturing at the Academy, classics lecture, compilation, first lecture, Hanlin visit, and spirit-tablet copying also had banquets by precedent.

sentences.zh: 衍聖公、正一真人來朝，纂實錄、會典皆於禮部設宴雲。

translations.literal: When the Duke of Continuing Sage and the True One of Orthodox Unity came to court, or when veritable records and institutional compilations were completed—banquets at the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When the Duke of Continuing Sage and the True One of Orthodox Unity came, or veritable records and codes were finished—banquets at the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 上尊號徽號儀清初太祖、太宗建元，群臣皆上尊號，其禮即登極儀也。

translations.literal: Honorific title and emblem title rites: In early Qing when Taizu and Taizong established eras, ministers all offered honorific titles—the rite was the enthronement rite.
translations.idiomatic: Honorific and emblem title rites: Early Qing Taizu and Taizong eras had ministers offer honorific titles—the enthronement rite.

sentences.zh: 康熙中，臣民合辭擬上尊號。

translations.literal: In Kangxi subjects jointly drafted an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi subjects jointly drafted an honorific title.

sentences.zh: 至六旬聖壽，復籥請。

translations.literal: At the sixtieth sacred birthday they again memorialized requesting.
translations.idiomatic: At the sixtieth sacred birthday they memorialized again.

sentences.zh: 聖祖諭言無裨治道，皆不允行。

translations.literal: Shengzu said it did not benefit governing the Way and would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Shengzu said it did not benefit governance and refused.

sentences.zh: 迄高宗敉定邊陲，王大臣猶以上尊號請，亦未俞納。

translations.literal: When Gaozong had pacified the frontiers, great ministers still requested an honorific title; he also did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong pacified the frontiers, great ministers still requested; he also refused.

sentences.zh: 惟新君踐阼，奉母后為皇太后、皇太后為太皇太后，則上尊號。

translations.literal: Only when a new ruler ascended and made his mother empress dowager and the empress dowager grand empress dowager was an honorific title bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Only when a new ruler made his mother empress dowager and the empress dowager grand empress dowager was an honorific bestowed.

sentences.zh: 國家行大慶，則上徽號，或二字、或四字，遞進以致推崇。

translations.literal: When the state held a great celebration an emblem title was bestowed—two or four characters, advanced in succession to show exaltation.
translations.idiomatic: At great state celebrations an emblem title was bestowed—two or four characters in succession.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，上孝庄皇后尊號，其徽號曰「昭聖慈壽」。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 8 the honorific title of Empress Xiaozhuang was bestowed; the emblem title was "Brilliant Sage, Kind, and Long-lived."
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 8 Empress Xiaozhuang's honorific was bestowed; the emblem was "Brilliant Sage, Kind, and Long-lived."

sentences.zh: 先期祭告，帝躬上奏書。

translations.literal: Beforehand reports were made; the emperor personally presented the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Beforehand reports were made; the emperor personally presented the memorial.

sentences.zh: 屆期太和殿陳皇帝法駕，慈寧宮陳皇太后儀駕，供設咸備。

translations.literal: On the day the emperor's legal guard was arrayed at the Hall of Supreme Harmony; the empress dowager's guard at the Cining Palace; offerings fully prepared.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor's guard at the Hall of Supreme Harmony; the empress dowager's at Cining; offerings prepared.

sentences.zh: 王公集太和門，大臣集右翼門，各官集午門，分翼立。

translations.literal: Princes assembled at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; great ministers at the Right Wing Gate; each official at the Meridian Gate—standing by wing.
translations.idiomatic: Princes at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; great ministers at the Right Wing Gate; officials at the Meridian Gate by wing.

sentences.zh: 帝升殿，中和韶樂作，奏海上蟠桃章，帝閱冊、寶畢，執事官分置亭內，鑾儀校舁行，前冊亭，後寶亭。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended; Zhonghe music played the Sea-Pacing Peach movement; when he had reviewed the patent and seal, officiators placed them in the pavilion; guard bearers carried them—the patent pavilion first, the seal pavilion after.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended; Zhonghe played Sea-Pacing Peach; after reviewing patent and seal, officiators placed them in pavilions; guards carried—patent first, seal after.

sentences.zh: 帝率群臣從駕至慈寧門，入宮立陛東，禮部侍郎、內閣學士奉冊、寶入，大學士奉宣讀冊、寶文入，侍立左旁，帝就拜位，王公百官依班位序立。

translations.literal: The emperor led ministers following the guard to the Cining Gate, entered the palace, and stood east of the steps; a vice minister of Rites and a Grand Secretariat academician carried patent and seal in; Grand Secretaries carried the texts to read aloud in and stood at the left; the emperor went to the kneeling place; princes and officials stood by rank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor led ministers to Cining, stood east of the steps; a vice minister and academician carried patent and seal in; Grand Secretaries read texts at the left; the emperor at the kneeling place; princes and officials by rank.

sentences.zh: 皇太后御宮，中和韶樂作，奏豫平章，升座，樂止。

translations.literal: The empress dowager entered the palace; Zhonghe music played the Yuping movement; she ascended; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager entered; Zhonghe played Yuping; she ascended; music ceased.

sentences.zh: 贊「跪」，帝率群臣跪。

translations.literal: The herald called "Kneel"; the emperor led the ministers in kneeling.
translations.idiomatic: The herald called "Kneel"; the emperor led ministers in kneeling.

sentences.zh: 奏「進冊」，大學士右旁跪進，興，退，帝受冊，恭獻，大學士左旁跪接，興，陳中案。

translations.literal: Music called "Present the patent"; the Grand Secretary knelt and presented from the right, rose, withdrew; the emperor received the patent and reverently offered it; the Grand Secretary knelt to receive from the left, rose, and placed it on the central table.
translations.idiomatic: Music: "Present the patent"; the Grand Secretary presented from the right; the emperor received and offered it; the Grand Secretary received from the left and placed it on the central table.

sentences.zh: 奏「進寶」，如前儀。

translations.literal: Music called "Present the seal"—the same protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Music: "Present the seal"—the same.

sentences.zh: 贊「宣冊」，宣冊官至案前北面跪，啟函宣讀訖，仍納之，興，退。

translations.literal: The herald called "Proclaim the patent"; the proclaiming officer knelt north before the table, opened the case, read aloud, returned it, rose, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The herald: "Proclaim the patent"; the officer knelt, opened the case, read, returned it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 贊「宣寶」同，仍置原案。

translations.literal: The herald called "Proclaim the seal"—the same; replaced on the original table.
translations.idiomatic: The herald: "Proclaim the seal"—the same; replaced on the original table.

sentences.zh: 女官四人舉案陳宮階上。

translations.literal: Four female officers lifted the table and placed it on the palace steps.
translations.idiomatic: Four female officers lifted the table to the palace steps.

sentences.zh: 丹陛大樂作，奏益平章，帝率群臣三跪九叩。

translations.literal: Dandi grand music played the Yiping movement; the emperor led the ministers in three kneelings and nine kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: Dandi played Yiping; the emperor led ministers in three kneelings and nine kowtows.

sentences.zh: 午門外各官承傳隨班行禮。

translations.literal: Officials outside the Meridian Gate performed the rite by relay following the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Officials outside the Meridian Gate followed by relay.

sentences.zh: 禮成，皇太后起座，中和韶樂作，奏履平章，還宮。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete the empress dowager rose; Zhonghe music played the Lüping movement; she returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When complete the empress dowager rose; Zhonghe played Lüping; she returned.

sentences.zh: 皇后率六宮、公主以下詣宮慶賀。

translations.literal: The empress led the six palaces and princesses down to the palace to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: The empress led the six palaces and princesses to congratulate.

sentences.zh: 翼日，帝御太和殿，王公百官上表慶賀，頒詔如制。

translations.literal: The next day the emperor entered the Hall of Supreme Harmony; princes and officials presented memorials and congratulated; an edict was promulgated as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: Next day the emperor entered the Hall of Supreme Harmony; princes and officials congratulated; an edict promulgated.

sentences.zh: 是歲大婚禮成，加上徽號禮亦如之。

translations.literal: That year when the grand wedding was complete, adding an emblem title followed the same rite.
translations.idiomatic: That year after the grand wedding, adding an emblem title followed the same rite.

sentences.zh: 康熙初元，加上徽號，時以諒陰，不奏書，不行禮，不朝賀。

translations.literal: In Kangxi's first year an emblem title was added; because of mourning for the father, no memorial was presented, no rite performed, no court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi's first year an emblem title was added; in mourning for the father, no memorial, rite, or congratulations.

sentences.zh: 凡大婚、親政、冊立皇后、武功告成、皇太后大慶、上徽號並如常儀。

translations.literal: Grand wedding, personal rule, investiture of empress, military success reported, empress dowager great celebration, and emblem titles all followed the regular protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Grand wedding, personal rule, empress investiture, military success, empress dowager celebrations, and emblem titles followed regular protocol.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，金川平，上徽號，皇太后諭帝春秋高，不宜過勞，令豫陳冊寶，至時行禮，罷宣讀表文，後仿此。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 41 when Jinchuan was pacified an emblem title was bestowed; the empress dowager said the emperor's years were high and he should not overwork; she ordered the patent and seal prepared beforehand and only the rite performed at the time; proclaiming the memorial was discontinued; afterward this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 when Jinchuan was pacified an emblem was bestowed; the empress dowager said the emperor should not overwork; patent and seal were prepared beforehand; proclaiming the memorial discontinued; afterward followed.

sentences.zh: 道光九年，平回疆，上皇太后徽號，緬甸國王遣使進金葉賀表，緬王進表自此始。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 9 when Turkestan was pacified an emblem title was bestowed on the empress dowager; the king of Burma sent envoys with a golden-leaf congratulatory memorial—Burmese royal memorials began here.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 9 when Turkestan was pacified an emblem for the empress dowager; Burma's king sent golden-leaf congratulations—Burmese royal memorials began here.

sentences.zh: 尊封太妃進冊寶如前儀，唯內監舉案陳太妃座前，帝行禮，太妃起避立座旁。

translations.literal: Ennobling grand consort with patent and seal followed the former protocol, only eunuchs lifted the table before the grand consort's seat; the emperor performed the rite; the grand consort rose and stood aside from the seat.
translations.idiomatic: Ennobling grand consort followed former protocol; eunuchs placed the table before her seat; the emperor performed the rite; she stood aside.

sentences.zh: 次日御殿受賀同。

translations.literal: The next day entering the hall to receive congratulations was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Next day receiving congratulations in the hall was the same.

sentences.zh: 若遣官將事，禮部尚書朝服詣內閣，冊寶舁出，偕大學士送之，至宮門外，內監入獻太妃、太嬪，受訖，禮成。

translations.literal: If officers were dispatched, the Minister of Rites in court dress went to the Grand Secretariat; patent and seal were carried out and, with Grand Secretaries, sent to the palace gate; eunuchs entered and presented to grand consort and grand concubine; when received the rite was complete.
translations.idiomatic: If officers were dispatched, the Minister of Rites in court dress fetched patent and seal from the Grand Secretariat and sent them to the gate; eunuchs presented to grand consort and grand concubine.

sentences.zh: 冊寶初制用金，康、乾時兼用嘉玉，道光後專以玉為之。

translations.literal: Patents and seals were originally gold; in Kangxi and Qianlong jade was also used; after Daoguang only jade was used.
translations.idiomatic: Patents and seals were originally gold; Kangxi and Qianlong also used jade; after Daoguang only jade.

sentences.zh: 凡尊封皇貴妃、貴太嬪，並用冊寶，太妃用冊印，太嬪用冊。

translations.literal: For ennobling imperial noble consort and noble grand concubine both patent and seal were used; grand consort used patent and seal-stamp; grand concubine patent only.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial noble consort and noble grand concubine used patent and seal; grand consort patent and stamp; grand concubine patent only.

sentences.zh: 冊立中宮儀崇德初元，孝端文皇后以嫡妃正位中宮，始行冊立禮。

translations.literal: Investiture of the empress: Early in Chongde the Filial and Upright Literary Empress as principal consort took the central palace and investiture rites began.
translations.idiomatic: Investiture of the empress: Early Chongde the principal consort took the central palace and investiture began.

sentences.zh: 是日設黃幄清寧宮前，幄內陳黃案，其東冊寶案。

translations.literal: That day a yellow canopy was set before the Palace of Pure Tranquility; within the canopy a yellow table; east of it patent and seal tables.
translations.idiomatic: That day a yellow canopy before Pure Tranquility; within, a yellow table; east, patent and seal tables.

sentences.zh: 王公百官集崇政殿，皇帝御殿閱冊寶。

translations.literal: Princes and officials assembled at the Chongzheng Hall; the emperor entered the hall and reviewed patent and seal.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and officials at the Chongzheng Hall; the emperor reviewed patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 正、副使二人持節，執事官舉冊寶至黃幄前，皇后出迎。

translations.literal: Principal and deputy envoys held staffs; officiators carried patent and seal to before the yellow canopy; the empress came out to welcome.
translations.idiomatic: Principal and deputy envoys held staffs; officiators carried patent and seal; the empress welcomed.

sentences.zh: 使者奉冊寶陳案上，西鄉立，宣讀冊文，具滿、蒙、漢三體，以次授右女官，女官跪接獻皇后，後以次跪受，轉授左女官，亦跪接，陳黃案。

translations.literal: Envoys placed patent and seal on the table and stood west; the patent text was read in Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese; in turn the right female officer received it; the female officer knelt and presented to the empress; she knelt in turn to receive and handed to the left female officer, who also knelt, received, and placed it on the yellow table.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys placed patent and seal west; trilingual text read; right female officer received and presented; the empress knelt to receive and handed left; placed on the yellow table.

sentences.zh: 次宣寶、受寶亦如之。

translations.literal: Next the seal was proclaimed and received likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The seal was proclaimed and received likewise.

sentences.zh: 使者出，覆命，皇后率公主、福晉、命婦至崇政殿御前六肅三跪三叩。

translations.literal: The envoys withdrew and reported; the empress led princesses, fujin, and wives before the Chongzheng Hall to the emperor with six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys reported; the empress led princesses, fujin, and wives to the emperor with six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 畢，還宮升座，妃率公主等行禮，王公百官上表慶賀，賜宴如常儀。

translations.literal: When finished she returned, ascended the throne; consorts led princesses to perform the rite; princes and officials presented memorials and congratulated; a banquet was granted as usual.
translations.idiomatic: She returned and ascended; consorts led princesses; princes and officials congratulated; banquet as usual.

sentences.zh: 康熙十六年，冊立孝昭仁皇后，前期補行納采、大徵如大婚禮。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 16 when the Filial and Manifest Benevolent Empress was invested, beforehand betrothal and grand gift rites were supplemented like the grand wedding.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16 investiture of the Filial and Manifest Benevolent Empress supplemented betrothal and grand gift like grand wedding.

sentences.zh: 親詣奉先殿告祭，天地、太廟後殿則遣官祭告。

translations.literal: The emperor personally reported at the Ancestral Temple; Heaven, Earth, and the rear hall of the Grand Temple were reported by dispatched officers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reported at the Ancestral Temple; Heaven, Earth, and Grand Temple rear hall by dispatched officers.

sentences.zh: 至日設節案太和殿中，東西肆；

translations.literal: On the day a staff table was set in the center of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, east and west;
translations.idiomatic: That day a staff table center of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, east and west;

sentences.zh: 左右各設案一，南北肆。

translations.literal: left and right one table each, north and south.
translations.idiomatic: left and right one table each, north and south.

sentences.zh: 帝御殿閱冊寶，王公百官序立，正、副使立丹陛上，北鄉，宣制官立殿中門左。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the hall and reviewed patent and seal; princes and officials stood in order; principal and deputy envoys stood on the red steps facing north; the proclaiming officer stood left of the central gate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reviewed patent and seal; princes and officials in order; envoys on red steps north; proclaiming officer left of central gate.

sentences.zh: 宣制曰：「某年月日，冊立妃某氏為皇后，命卿等持節行禮。

translations.literal: The proclamation said: "On such-and-such a year, month, and day, Consort So-and-so is invested as empress; you are ordered to hold the staff and perform the rite."
translations.idiomatic: The proclamation: "On such a date, Consort So-and-so is invested empress; hold the staff and perform the rite."

sentences.zh: 」於是正、副使持節前行，校尉舁冊寶亭出協和門，至景運門，以冊寶節授內監，奉至宮門，皇后迎受。

translations.literal: Thereupon principal and deputy envoys advanced with staffs; guards carried the patent and seal pavilion out the Gate of Harmonious Unity to the Jingyun Gate; patent, seal, and staff were handed to eunuchs and carried to the palace gate; the empress welcomed and received.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys advanced; guards carried the pavilion to Jingyun Gate; eunuchs carried patent, seal, and staff; the empress welcomed.

sentences.zh: 行禮畢，內監出，還節使者，使者覆命，帝率群臣詣太皇太后、皇太后宮行禮。

translations.literal: When the rite was finished eunuchs came out and returned the staff to the envoys; the envoys reported; the emperor led ministers to the grand empress dowager and empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: When finished eunuchs returned the staff; envoys reported; the emperor led ministers to both empresses dowager.

sentences.zh: 翼日，皇后禮服詣兩宮及帝座前行禮。

translations.literal: The next day the empress in court dress performed the rite before both palaces and the emperor's throne.
translations.idiomatic: Next day the empress in court dress performed rites before both palaces and the throne.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，冊立孝賢純皇后，如常儀。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 2 investiture of the Filial and Worthy Pure Empress followed the regular protocol.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 investiture of the Filial and Worthy Pure Empress followed regular protocol.

sentences.zh: 命頒詔，著為家法。

translations.literal: An edict was ordered promulgated and made household law.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was promulgated and made household law.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，立孝淑睿皇后，冊命日，會太上皇帝千秋宴訖還宮，帝、後詣前行禮。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 1 when the Filial and Quiet Wise Empress was invested, on the patent day after the retired emperor's longevity banquet returned to the palace, the emperor and empress went before him to perform the rite.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 on the patent day, after the retired emperor's longevity banquet, the emperor and empress performed the rite before him.

sentences.zh: 帝御殿，正、副使持節，禮成，先詣太上皇宮門前覆命，餘如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the hall; principal and deputy envoys held staffs; when the rite was finished they first reported before the retired emperor's palace gate; the rest as usual.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the hall; envoys held staffs; when finished they first reported at the retired emperor's gate; rest as usual.

sentences.zh: 冊封妃、嬪，亦自崇德初元始，四妃同日受封，屆時命使持節冊封如禮。

translations.literal: Investiture of consorts and concubines also began early in Chongde; four consorts were ennobled the same day; on the day envoys were ordered to hold staffs and invest by protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Investiture of consorts and concubines began early Chongde; four consorts same day; envoys with staffs by protocol.

sentences.zh: 妃等率公主、福晉、命婦詣帝前六肅三跪三叩，後前亦如之，妃前則行四肅二跪二叩，妃等相對各二肅一跪一叩。

translations.literal: Consorts led princesses, fujin, and wives before the emperor with six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows; before the empress likewise; before a consort four courtesies, two kneelings, and two kowtows; consorts to each other two courtesies, one kneeling, and one kowtow.
translations.idiomatic: Consorts led wives to the emperor with six courtesies, three kneelings, three kowtows; before the empress likewise; before a consort four courtesies, two kneelings, two kowtows; consorts to each other two courtesies, one kneeling, one kowtow.

sentences.zh: 康熙時，貴妃、七嬪與中宮同日封，諸嬪有冊無寶。

translations.literal: In Kangxi the noble consort and seven pin were ennobled the same day as the central palace; lesser consorts had patents without seals.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi noble consort and seven pin were ennobled with the empress; lesser consorts had patents without seals.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，定皇妃攝六宮事，體制宜崇，祭告如冊中宮儀。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 13 when the imperial consort administered the six palaces, ritual weight was increased; reports were like empress investiture.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 when the imperial consort administered six palaces, reports matched empress investiture.

sentences.zh: 次日朝皇太后，拜跪甬路左旁。

translations.literal: The next day audience at the empress dowager; bowing and kneeling left of the central path.
translations.idiomatic: Next day audience at empress dowager; bowing left of the central path.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，諭嗣後封嬪罷祭告，即與妃同日受封亦然，著為令。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 3 an edict said hereafter ennobling pin discontinued reports; even ennobling with consorts the same day was likewise—made regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 3 ennobling pin discontinued reports; even same-day with consorts—made regulation.

sentences.zh: 冊立皇太子儀康熙十四年，立嫡子允礽為皇太子，先期祭告，玉帛香版，皆皇帝躬視。

translations.literal: Investiture of crown prince: In Kangxi 14 the legitimate son Yunreng was invested crown prince; beforehand reports were made; jade, silk, and incense were all personally viewed by the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince investiture: Kangxi 14 Yunreng invested; beforehand reports; jade, silk, and incense personally viewed by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 屆日御殿傳制，與冊立中宮同。

translations.literal: On the day he entered the hall and transmitted the decree—as in empress investiture.
translations.idiomatic: That day he entered the hall and transmitted the decree—as for empress investiture.

sentences.zh: 正使授冊，副使授寶。

translations.literal: The principal envoy presented the patent; the deputy presented the seal.
translations.idiomatic: Principal envoy presented patent; deputy presented seal.

sentences.zh: 行禮畢，正、副使覆命。

translations.literal: When the rite was finished principal and deputy envoys reported.
translations.idiomatic: When finished principal and deputy envoys reported.

sentences.zh: 帝率皇太子祭告奉先殿，皇太子拜褥敷檻外，並詣帝、後宮行禮。

translations.literal: The emperor led the crown prince to report at the Ancestral Temple; the crown prince's kneeling cushion was spread outside the railing; he also performed the rite before the emperor and empress.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor led the crown prince to the Ancestral Temple; kneeling cushion outside the railing; also before emperor and empress.

sentences.zh: 翼日，帝御殿受賀、頒詔如常儀。

translations.literal: The next day the emperor entered the hall, received congratulations, and promulgated an edict as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Next day the emperor received congratulations and promulgated an edict as usual.

sentences.zh: 王公進箋皇太子前致慶，皇太子詣武英殿與親、郡王等行禮。

translations.literal: Princes presented felicitations before the crown prince; the crown prince went to the Hall of Military Glory to perform the rite with imperial and commandery princes.
translations.idiomatic: Princes felicitated before the crown prince; he went to the Hall of Military Glory with princes.

sentences.zh: 外省文武官並箋賀如儀。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of outer provinces also felicitated by memorial as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: Outer-province civil and military officials felicitated by memorial as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 遇太子千秋節，太子先詣奉先殿致祭，隨詣皇帝前行禮，還毓慶宮，旋御惇本殿受賀。

translations.literal: On the crown prince's longevity festival he first reported at the Ancestral Temple, then performed the rite before the emperor, returned to the Palace of Cultivation of Youth, then entered the Hall of Secure the Root to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On his longevity festival he reported at the Ancestral Temple, performed before the emperor, returned to Cultivation of Youth, then Secure the Root for congratulations.

sentences.zh: 王公百官二跪六叩，畢，還宮，群臣退。

translations.literal: Princes and officials performed two kneelings and six kowtows; when finished he returned; ministers withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and officials two kneelings and six kowtows; when finished he returned; ministers withdrew.

sentences.zh: 厥後允礽廢立，迄晚年儲位未定。

translations.literal: Afterward Yunreng was deposed and reinstalled; to old age the heir's place was unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Yunreng was deposed and restored; to old age the heir was unsettled.

sentences.zh: 五十年後，大學士王掞七上密疏，請建國本，六十年，復申前請，觸聖怒。

translations.literal: Fifty years later Grand Secretary Wang Yan seven times submitted secret memorials requesting establishment of the heir; in year 60 he repeated the request and provoked imperial anger.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty years later Wang Yan seven secret memorials for an heir; in year 60 he repeated and provoked anger.

sentences.zh: 至乾、嘉後，始明宣不立儲貳諭旨，開國固未嘗有也。

translations.literal: From Qianlong and Jiaqing onward edicts clearly declared no establishment of an heir apparent—the founding had never had it.
translations.idiomatic: From Qianlong and Jiaqing edicts declared no heir apparent—the founding never had it.

sentences.zh: 冊封諸王儀崇德元年，定冊封日，王、貝勒序立崇政殿前，內院官奉制冊、印陳於案，俟旨授封。

translations.literal: Investiture of princes: In Chongde 1 the investiture day was fixed; princes and beile stood in order before the Chongzheng Hall; Inner Court officers placed patent and seal on the table and, awaiting the decree, granted ennoblement.
translations.idiomatic: Investiture of princes: Chongde 1 investiture day fixed; princes and beile before Chongzheng Hall; Inner Court placed patent and seal awaiting decree.

sentences.zh: 諸王等皆跪，宣冊官、奉冊官並立案東，次第宣畢，奉冊、印授諸王等。

translations.literal: All princes knelt; proclaiming and presenting officers stood east of the table; when each was read they presented patent and seal to the princes.
translations.idiomatic: All knelt; proclaiming officers east of the table; when read they presented patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 王等祗受，轉授從官，復位。

translations.literal: Princes reverently received and handed to attendants and returned to place.
translations.idiomatic: Princes received, handed to attendants, and returned.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，隨奉冊官赴清寧宮，詣帝、後前行禮，三跪九叩。

translations.literal: When the rite was finished they followed the presenting officer to the Palace of Pure Tranquility and performed the rite before the emperor and empress with three kneelings and nine kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: When finished they followed to Pure Tranquility and performed three kneelings and nine kowtows before emperor and empress.

sentences.zh: 遂出大清門，諸王等互賀，俱二跪六叩。

translations.literal: Then out the Daqing Gate princes congratulated each other—all two kneelings and six kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: Then out Daqing Gate princes congratulated each other—two kneelings and six kowtows.

sentences.zh: 還邸，福晉、夫人各行慶賀。

translations.literal: Returning to residence, fujin and wives performed congratulations; staff congratulated princes—two kneelings and six kowtows; beile's staff one kneeling and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: At residence fujin and wives congratulated; staff to princes two kneelings six kowtows; beile staff one kneeling three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 府僚致賀諸王，二跪六叩，貝勒僚屬一跪三叩。

translations.literal: Staff congratulated the princes—two kneelings and six kowtows; a beile's staff one kneeling and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: Staff congratulated princes—two kneelings and six kowtows; a beile's staff one kneeling and three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年定制，凡冊封，簡正、副使二人，前一日，殿堂上設節案，香案，冊寶案，堂前儀衛、樂懸備陳。

translations.literal: Fixed in Kangxi 12: for each investiture principal and deputy envoys were chosen; the day before, on the hall a staff table, incense table, and patent and seal table; before the hall guard and music fully arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 12: each investiture chose principal and deputy envoys; the day before staff, incense, and patent tables; guard and music before the hall.

sentences.zh: 屆期，正、副使詣太和殿奉節出，校尉舁冊寶亭赴王府，王率府僚跪迎門外。

translations.literal: On the day principal and deputy envoys went to the Hall of Supreme Harmony, received staffs, and left; guards carried the patent and seal pavilion to the princely residence; the prince led staff to kneel and welcome outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: That day envoys received staffs at the Hall of Supreme Harmony; guards carried the pavilion to the residence; the prince knelt outside the gate.

sentences.zh: 正、副使奉冊寶節分陳各案，立節案東，王立案西。

translations.literal: Principal and deputy envoys placed patent, seal, and staff on each table and stood east of the staff table; the prince stood west.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys placed patent, seal, and staff on tables; stood east of the staff table; the prince stood west.

sentences.zh: 行禮畢，王詣香案前跪，聽宣制冊，使者授冊寶，王祗受，復位，行禮如初。

translations.literal: When the rite was finished the prince knelt before the incense table, heard the patent proclaimed, received patent and seal from the envoy, returned to place, and performed the rite as at first.
translations.idiomatic: When finished the prince knelt at the incense table, heard the patent, received patent and seal, returned, and performed as before.

sentences.zh: 使者奉節覆命，王率府僚跪送，迎送俱用樂。

translations.literal: The envoy returned the staff and reported; the prince led staff to kneel and escort; welcome and send-off both used music.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy returned the staff; the prince escorted kneeling; welcome and send-off with music.

sentences.zh: 封親王曰寶，郡王曰印，貝勒有制冊無印。

translations.literal: A commandery prince received a seal, a commandery prince's son an imprint; a beile had a statutory patent without imprint.
translations.idiomatic: A commandery prince received a seal, his son an imprint; a beile had a patent without imprint.

sentences.zh: 行禮謝恩並同。

translations.literal: Rite, gratitude, and report were all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Rite, gratitude, and report were the same.

sentences.zh: 初制，封親王世子用金冊，郡王鍍金銀冊，貝勒授誥命，旋改用紙制冊。

translations.literal: Originally an imperial prince's son received a gold patent, a commandery prince a gilded silver patent, a beile an edict of appointment—soon paper patents were used.
translations.idiomatic: Originally an imperial prince's son received a gold patent, a commandery prince gilded silver, a beile an edict—soon paper patents.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，諭冊封親王用銀質鍍金，以恭親王奕訢王爵世襲，仍制金冊。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng 10 an edict said commandery princes used silver gilded with gold; because Prince Gong Yixin's princedom was hereditary, a gold patent was still made.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10 commandery princes used silver gilded with gold; Prince Gong Yixin's hereditary title still received a gold patent.

sentences.zh: 冊封公主，封使至，公主率侍女迎儀門右，使者奉制冊入，陳門前黃案上，移置堂前幄內。

translations.literal: Investiture of princesses: When the envoy arrived the princess led maids of honor to welcome right of the ceremonial gate; the envoy carried the patent in, placed it on the yellow table before the gate, and moved it to the table in the canopy before the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Investiture of princesses: When the envoy arrived the princess welcomed right of the ceremonial gate; the envoy placed the patent on the yellow table and moved it into the hall canopy.

sentences.zh: 公主升西階，六肅三跪三叩，宣訖，授侍女，公主跪受，行禮如初。

translations.literal: The princess ascended the western steps with six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows; when the reading was finished she gave it to a maid; the princess knelt to receive and performed the rite as at first.
translations.idiomatic: The princess ascended the western steps with six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows; when the reading was finished she gave it to a maid; she knelt to receive and performed the rite as before.

sentences.zh: 使者覆命，仍送儀門外。

translations.literal: The envoy reported and still escorted outside the ceremonial gate.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy reported and escorted outside the ceremonial gate.

sentences.zh: 是日帝升殿，公主至御前，次入後宮，並六肅三跪三叩。

translations.literal: That day the emperor ascended the hall; the princess came before the throne, then entered the inner palace—each with six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor ascended the hall; the princess came before the throne, then the inner palace—each with six courtesies, three kneelings, and three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 又次詣諸妃前，各四肅二跪二叩，還府，府屬慶賀，餘如封親王儀。

translations.literal: Next she went before each consort, each with four courtesies, two kneelings, and two kowtows; returning to the residence the household staff congratulated; the rest like commandery prince investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Next she went before each consort with four courtesies, two kneelings, and two kowtows; at the residence the household staff congratulated; the rest like commandery prince investiture.

sentences.zh: 凡固倫公主、和碩公主，同輩者封長公主，長者封大長公主，並給金冊雲。

translations.literal: For all gulun princesses and heshuo princesses, peers were ennobled chief princess, elders chief grand princess, and all were granted gold patents.
translations.idiomatic: For all gulun and heshuo princesses, peers were ennobled chief princess and elders chief grand princess, and all were granted gold patents.
